title: radiogrammitis ligulata
intro: Radiogrammitis ligulata, commonly known as the False Lip Wrap Fern, is a type of plant species belonging to the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
